question:
The pie chart given here shows the spending by a family on various items during the year 2000. Study the graph and answer these questions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd7f54b9f86e227c3e16eaaf32db086f4c0adaeca2ce5323f42b35dfc803c6ba.png] 

The ratio of the total amount of money spent on housing to that spent on education was:
solution:
**Calculation:**

Amount spent on housing : amount spent on education

⇒ 15 : 12 = 5 : 4

**∴ The correct option is 5 : 4.**
